title: Measuring the Cost Share Accumulated for the Contract Year on a Ridgecrest Advantage Enrollment
content:
The cost share accumulated for the contract year on a Ridgecrest Advantage Medicare Advantage Health Plan enrollment is measured from the claim lines standing on that enrollment, and which of them are measured follows whether a coverage end date is recorded on the enrollment and how many claim lines stand adjudicated on it.

| What the enrollment shows | The cost share accumulated for the contract year |
| --- | --- |
| No coverage end date is recorded on the enrollment and at least 3 claim lines stand adjudicated on it | The member cost share of every claim line standing on the enrollment, with the liability backed out by reversals counted as negative |
| A coverage end date is recorded on the enrollment and at least 3 claim lines stand adjudicated on it | The member cost share of the claim lines processed in the last 3 months |
| Fewer than 3 claim lines stand adjudicated on the enrollment | The member cost share of every adjudicated claim line standing on the enrollment |

The third row is reached on the count of adjudicated claim lines alone: with 0, 1 or 2 of them standing on the enrollment, whether a coverage end date is recorded makes no difference.

The first row is the one measure that takes in reversals as well as adjudicated lines, the liability a reversal backs out being counted as a negative figure against the total.

*Hypothetical case: an enrollment carrying 5 adjudicated claim lines with member cost share of 40.00, 35.00, 60.00, 25.00 and 50.00 USD, and a reversal backing out 35.00 USD; the two most recent lines, of 25.00 and 50.00 USD, were processed inside the last 3 months.* With no coverage end date recorded, the accumulated cost share is 210.00 USD less the 35.00 USD backed out, so 175.00 USD. With a coverage end date recorded, it is 75.00 USD.
